pair.title: Pair your first OldPhoneKiosk panel
pair.description:
Open the OldPhoneKiosk iOS app and scan this QR code. After the app connects, come back here and press Submit.

![OldPhoneKiosk pairing QR]({qr_svg_data_uri})

If the QR is not visible in your Home Assistant theme, use the iOS fallback: Settings → Pairing → Paste pairing payload, then paste this payload:

```json
{payload}
```

error.waiting_for_phone: Waiting for the phone/tablet to scan the QR and connect. Leave this screen open, scan from the app, then press Submit again.
error.not_connected: The QR was scanned or expired, but the phone/tablet is not connected yet. If needed, restart the flow and scan the new QR.

abort.already_configured: OldPhoneKiosk is already configured. Add more panels from the integration page or remove the existing entry first.
